title: Portal: revoke a packages token
summary: The confirmation behind Revoke on Account → Packages: it names the token and the machine where package installs stop and how to set that machine up again.
compare: Opens over Account → Packages; a small danger dialog with the warning icon.
The title names the token by its label: 'Revoke “pkey feeds setup on mara-mbp”?'.

The body says what stops in plain words (the package managers on mara-mbp can't reach DJDL's or Diceroll's packages) and how to undo it (run 'pkey feeds setup --write' there again). The title names the token, so no line repeats which one keeps working.
Phone: the kit's bottom sheet with the buttons pinned full width, the danger button on top.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

Portal v2 (B2, B12): the docked header, the one filled primary is ink, tile actions outlined, the page h1 at the display step (48/52, 32/36 on a phone) with no full stop or eyebrow, no glow or wash, no chartreuse; text never painted over art; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: 4 UX designers, triaged by a lead designer
designReview.verdict: Spacing and copy trimmed per the multi-review triage; see findings.

findings.issue: Revoke copy is longer than it needs to be.
findings.resolution: 'Package managers on mara-mbp lose access to DJDL and Diceroll. Run pkey feeds setup --write there to reconnect.'
